settings.title: What makes Fragrance of Virtue incense special ?
settings.content:
All our products are charcoal-free, eco-conscious, and crafted from natural
ingredients. With a family legacy since 1961, we blend tradition with modern wellness.

settings.title: What are the benefits of using incense ?
settings.content: Incense helps in pooja & rituals, meditation, yoga, aromatherapy, relaxation, stress relief, mood upliftment, and better sleep.

settings.title: Are FOV incense sticks safe for daily use ?
settings.content:
Yes. Our incense sticks are non-toxic, vegan-friendly, and made without harmful
chemicals, making them safe for everyday use.

settings.title: How long does one incense stick burn ?
settings.content: Each stick is 9 inches long and burns for about 60 minutes, filling your space with a long-lasting fragrance.

settings.title: What types of incense products do you offer?
settings.content: We offer incense sticks, dhoop cones, sambrani cups, kapoor, wellness packs, pooja ritual packs, aromatherapy ranges, and curated gift boxes.

settings.title: What is the Genie Pick feature ?
settings.content: 🧞 Genie Pick is an interactive tool where our Genie helps you choose the right incense for your mood, zodiac, manifestation, or spiritual needs.

settings.title: Can I create my own incense pack ?
settings.content: Yes! Our “Create Your Own Pack” option lets you select fragrances that suit your rituals, wellness goals, or gifting preferences.

settings.title: Do you offer gift options ?
settings.content: Absolutely! We have beautifully designed incense gift boxes for festivals, weddings, housewarmings, and corporate gifting, each with eco-friendly seed paper 🌱.

settings.title: How do I place an order ?
settings.content: Simply browse categories (Wellness, Aromatherapy, Pooja & Rituals, Gift Boxes, Genie Pick), add products to your cart, and checkout in one step.

settings.title: How long does delivery take ?
settings.content: Orders are delivered within 4–7 business days across India. COD is available in most locations.

settings.title: Do you ship internationally ?
settings.content: Currently, we ship only across India, but international delivery will be launched soon.

settings.title: What is your return & refund policy ?
settings.content:
• Returns are accepted within 5 days of delivery only for damaged/defective products.
  • Customers must send a photo within 2–3 hours of delivery to +91 91521 12201.
  • Opened packs are not returnable due to pooja and religious sentiments.

settings.title: How can I cancel my order ?
settings.content: Orders can be cancelled before shipping via “My Orders” or by emailing fragranceofvirtue@gmail.com. Once shipped, the return policy applies.

settings.title: How can I track my order ?
settings.content: You will receive SMS/email updates with tracking details, or you can check under “My Orders” on our website.

settings.title: Do you offer discounts and loyalty rewards ?
settings.content: Yes! 🎡 Spin the Wheel for offers, write a review for 5% off, refer friends for extra discounts, and join our loyalty program for reward points.

settings.title: Are FOV incense products vegan-friendly ?
settings.content: Yes.All our products are 100% vegan and cruelty-free.

settings.title: How is FOV connected to tradition and community?
settings.content: We are a legacy brand since 1961, supporting cow shelters, reforestation, and women empowerment (90% women workforce) while bringing soulful fragrances to your home.

settings.title: How does incense help in aromatherapy ?
settings.content: Incense reduces stress, anxiety, and fatigue while promoting relaxation, positivity,and better sleep. It soothes the mind and uplifts the mood naturally.

settings.title: How are incense sticks useful during yoga ?
settings.content: Burning incense during yoga creates a calming atmosphere, helps focus the mind, boosts energy, and deepens relaxation.

settings.title: Are incense sticks and scented candles the same ?
settings.content: No. Candles are made of wax, while incense is made from natural herbs, resins, and oils. Incense spreads fragrance faster and is more cost-effective than candles.

settings.title: How are incense sticks made ?
settings.content: Incense sticks are made using hand-rolling, machine-dipping, or pressing methods with natural ingredients.

settings.title: How does incense release fragrance ?
settings.content: When lit, incense releases fragrant smoke that quickly spreads, filling your space with aroma.

settings.title: What are the types of Indian incense?
settings.content: Indian incense is mainly of two types: Masala incense (blended natural paste on sticks) and Charcoal incense (sticks dipped in oils).

settings.title: What are some safety tips for burning incense ?
settings.content: Burn incense in a ventilated space, never leave it unattended, and keep it away from children, pets, and fabrics. Avoid using around infants, asthmatic, or sensitive individuals.
